title: Haunted Hospitals
description:
S04 E02 — The Gift, Room 19, The Cooler
An orderly discovers his frightening gift for seeing spirits of the recently deceased and sensing those who are about to die; a hospice nurse realizes the end-of-life facility where she works is haunted by multiple spirits, including a black dog.

title: Haunted Hospitals
description:
S04 E03 — The Malevolent Boy, Cat
A nurse in Texas discovers her hospital is haunted by a mischievous boy whose pranks become increasingly malicious; a cook at a county hospital witnesses paranormal events in connection with the long-time janitor.

title: Haunted Hospitals
description:
S04 E04 — Creature, The Vigil, The Exorcist
A nurse aide discovers that her care facility contains a horrific creature that threatens her elderly patients; encounters in the hospital halls with a nefarious crone compels a teenager to hold vigil by her dying grandmother's bedside.

title: Haunted Hospitals
description:
S04 E05 — Connection, Ghost Interrupted, Terror in the Tunnel

title: Scariest Night of My Life
description:
S01 E10 — Kevin Help Us; Ghostman and Robin
The spirit of a dead cat returns to protect its owners from an unfriendly canine presence; a woman and her young daughter are terrorized by a menacing shadow man.

title: Celebrity Help! My House Is Haunted
description:
S03 E05 — Chloe Ferry
Tallying up the unsettling occurrences in reality star Chloe Ferry's isolated mansion, where things go missing and windows mysteriously shatter in the dead of night; learning about a terrifying shadow man and the home's link to the Geordie Ripper.

title: Paranormal Survivor
description:

title: Paranormal Survivor
description:

A woman gets more than she bargained for when she brings home an antique washstand; an evil spirit attaches itself to all those it encounters; a woman accidentally summons demonic beings into her home.

title: Paranormal Survivor
description:

title: Destination Haunted
description:

title: Destination Haunted
description:
